justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ClassInjector.java:1794-2360, which shows broad fan-out (it directly coordinates ClassLoader, ProtectionDomain, ClassFileLocator, ByteBuddy, JavaModule, UsingInstrumentation, AccessibleObject, Field, Method, and nested Dispatcher/Factory helpers). But fan-in is limited: repository search found only a small set of callers in byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ClassLoadingStrategy.java:545,634,672 and byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/agent/builder/AgentBuilder.java:4499-4522, plus three test/support files (ClassInjectorUsingUnsafeTest, ClassUnsafeInjectionAvailableRule, AgentBuilderInjectionStrategyTest/DefaultApplicationTest). That is not strong enough evidence of a dependency hub.
